name: gallopwire
description: GallopWire: a playable cyber-western baritone twang for your MIDI keys. Gallop engine over neon whistle, mouth harp, desert bass and hoof-clop kit on YOUR BPM/key/chords. DAW-grid WAV + MIDI export.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp index.html app.js styles.css dist/
